Quality_and_Efficiency_of_Implementation.criterion_name: Quality and Efficiency of the Implementation
Quality_and_Efficiency_of_Implementation.source_section: Section 3 — Quality and efficiency of the implementation

compliance_checklist.description: Scope check: the application must correspond, wholly or in part, to the topic description against which it has been submitted; evaluator must declare 'in scope' or 'out of scope' with explanation
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 — Other Questions — Scope of the application

compliance_checklist.description: Exceptional funding: any third-country participant or international organisation not listed in the General Annex to the Main Work Programme may only receive funding if their participation is essential for carrying out the project; must be assessed and listed by the evaluator
Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC): evaluator must determine whether the proposal involves hESC and, if so, assess whether such use is necessary to achieve the scientific objectives
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 — Other Questions — Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC)

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryos: evaluator must determine whether the proposal involves human embryos and, if so, assess how they will be used in the project
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 — Other Questions — Use of human embryos

compliance_checklist.description: Activities excluded from funding: proposal must not include activities aimed at human cloning for reproductive purposes, modification of heritable human genetic heritage (except cancer treatment of gonads), creation of human embryos solely for research or stem cell procurement, or destruction of human embryos; evaluator must confirm absence of excluded activities
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 — Other Questions — Activities excluded from funding

compliance_checklist.description: Exclusive focus on civil applications: proposed activities must not be intended for use in military applications or aimed at serving military purposes; evaluator must confirm civil-only focus
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 — Other Questions — Exclusive focus on civil applications

compliance_checklist.description: Overall scoring threshold: the sum of the three weighted criterion scores must reach or exceed 70 points out of 100 (each criterion scored 0-5 on a one-decimal-place scale, converted to /100 via declared weightings Excellence 50%, Impact 30%, Implementation 20%); weighting applies only for ranking and not for threshold determination

Lump sum budget assessment (if applicable): for proposals using a detailed lump sum budget, evaluator comments including concrete recommendations for any needed changes are required; evaluator must declare assessment completion
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 1 — Evaluation (lump sum option); Section 2 — Other Questions — Assessment of lump sum cost estimations
